items.design: A cute small coral pink sea lobster snugly sitting INSIDE a golden waffle ice-cream cone, a creamy vanilla swirl cradles its lower body like ice cream. Lobster head and both small claws emerge over rim, short curled antennae, tiny walking legs poke below sides of cone so it can walk on aquarium sand, cone tip angled back LEFT, head and eyes CLEARLY facing SCREEN RIGHT in side three-quarter view. Cone is a carried shell, not a cone hat. Compact body, unmistakable lobster claws
